findings.title: Imported HTML bypasses post sanitization
findings.body: This creates imported posts with `raw_html`, and `Post#cook` returns their raw content without passing it through the normal rendering/sanitization pipeline. Feed entries are remote, untrusted HTML, and the embed template renders `post.cooked` as raw HTML, so a malicious feed item can execute persistent JavaScript in visitors' browsers. Sanitize imported content before storing or rendering it.

findings.title: Referer is interpolated into executable JavaScript
findings.body: The request Referer is attacker-controlled and is inserted unescaped inside a JavaScript string. A Referer with the configured host but a crafted path can break out of the string and inject script into the forum's origin whenever the embed page is loaded. Pass a validated, serialized origin (not the full Referer) to `postMessage`.
